Package de.hof.dms.service

Class DocumentService

java.lang.Object
de.hof.dms.service.DocumentService
@Service @Profile("!no-mongo") public class DocumentService extends Object
Core document lifecycle service: uploading files (stored in GridFS with an allocated EAP number), reading metadata, downloading content, replacing content, updating metadata, soft-deleting, and reading/updating per-document permissions. Every operation enforces access through PermissionService, and deletion is a soft status change rather than a physical removal.

  • Constructor Details

    • DocumentService

      public DocumentService(DocumentRepository documentRepository, FolderRepository folderRepository, org.springframework.data.mongodb.gridfs.GridFsTemplate gridFsTemplate, EapNumberService eapNumberService, PermissionService permissionService, UploadValidationService uploadValidationService)
      Creates the document service with the repositories, GridFS template, and collaborating services it needs for the document lifecycle.
      Parameters:
      documentRepository - store for document metadata records
      folderRepository - store for parent folders
      gridFsTemplate - template used to store and stream binary content
      eapNumberService - allocator of EAP numbers on upload
      permissionService - resolver enforcing access on every operation
      uploadValidationService - validator applied to uploaded files

  • Method Details

    • upload

      public DocumentUploadResponse upload(org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile file, String title, String documentType, String parentId, String description, String eapCategory, boolean inheritFromParent, CurrentUser user)
      Validates and stores a new document: the file is validated, an EAP number is allocated, the binary is saved to GridFS, and an ACL plus initial OCR and indexing status are set. Requires create permission on the target parent folder.
      Throws:
      ApiException - with 400/404 for invalid metadata or a missing parent folder

    • getMetadata

      public DocumentMetadataResponse getMetadata(String id, CurrentUser user)
      Returns the metadata of an active document. Requires read permission.
      Throws:
      ApiException - with 404 if the document is missing or deleted

    • download

      public DocumentService.DownloadPayload download(String id, CurrentUser user)
      Streams the stored binary of an active document from GridFS. Requires read permission.
      Throws:
      ApiException - with 404 if the document or its stored file is missing

    • delete

      public void delete(String id, CurrentUser user)
      Soft-deletes a document by marking its status deleted; the record and its GridFS blob are retained. Requires delete permission.
      Throws:
      ApiException - with 404 if the document is missing or already deleted

    • setContent

      public DocumentMetadataResponse setContent(String id, org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile file, CurrentUser user)
      Replaces the binary content of an existing document (CMIS setContentStream). Requires update permission. The previous GridFS blob is removed and the stored file name, content type, and size are refreshed.

    • updateMetadata

      public DocumentMetadataResponse updateMetadata(String id, MetadataUpdateRequest request, CurrentUser user)
      Updates the editable metadata (title, description, document type) of an active document; blank fields are left unchanged. Requires update permission.
      Throws:
      ApiException - with 404 if the document is missing or deleted

    • getPermissions

      public PermissionsResponse getPermissions(String id, CurrentUser user)
      Returns the caller's effective permissions on a document, plus the full ACL only when the caller may manage permissions (admin or MANAGE_PERMISSIONS). Requires read permission.
      Throws:
      ApiException - with 404 if the document is missing or deleted

    • updatePermissions

      public AclDto updatePermissions(String id, AclDto request, CurrentUser user)
      Replaces a document's ACL with the supplied one. Requires manage_permissions on the document.
      Throws:
      ApiException - with 404 if the document is missing/deleted, or 400 if the ACL payload is null
